content.rendered:
Who do I notify if I am homeschooling my student?

  • Send notification to Kami Golden at kgolden@sherwood.k12.or.us or mail/hand-deliver to Sherwood School District, 21920 SW Sherwood Blvd, Sherwood, OR 97140 and include the following:
    • Student Name
    • Current Grade
    • Home Address
    • Parent Name
    • Parent Phone Number
  • Register with Northwest Regional ESD at https://www.nwresd.org/services-and-programs/home-school-notification.

Where do I submit my Intent to Enroll in a charter or online school?

  • Send Intent to Enroll form to Kami Golden at kgolden@sherwood.k12.or.us or mail/hand-deliver to Sherwood School District, 21920 SW Sherwood Blvd, Sherwood, OR 97140.

How do I request or submit a Student Transfer request?

  • Please click here to visit our Student Transfers page for additional information.
